title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 058
review_goal: Differentiate factory, fan, and filter variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Factory block with one tall stack above a zigzag roof and two windows
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a boxy factory building with a zigzag roof and window dots.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the cooling tower factory when the main shapes should be two tall towers.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds one tall stack, a sawtooth roof line, and two square windows.

items.depicts_observation: Five petal fan swirl with curved blades around a centered hub
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fan drawn as five curved swirl blades around the center.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the four loop fan when the blades should look like overlapping circles.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot forms the fan from five curved petals spinning around a small center gap.

items.depicts_observation: Four loop fan shape with round blade circles overlapping around a centered hub
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fan built from four round loop blades instead of swirl petals.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the five petal swirl fan when the blades should curl more sharply.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses four circular loop blades that overlap around the center.

items.depicts_observation: Funnel form with a wide top narrow neck and pointed lower tip
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classic funnel filter tapering to a pointed lower tip.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the stacked filter bars when the icon should be made from horizontal lines.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a full funnel shape with sloped sides and a narrow lower point.

items.depicts_observation: Three horizontal filter bars descending in length from top to bottom
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a filter mark drawn as three descending horizontal bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the funnel shaped filters when the icon should not taper into a neck.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the funnel with three short stacked bars of different lengths.
